title: Plan a new lesson
goal: Make a lesson plan with a title, notes and a checklist, then share and save it.

startState.note: The spring term lessons, nothing selected

intro: In this video, you plan a new lesson in Practice Planner, from a blank page to a saved and shared plan.
outro: That is a complete lesson plan. The next video in the playlist shows how to copy a lesson for another class.

steps.narration: Select New lesson on the toolbar. A blank lesson opens on the right.
steps.expect: A new untitled lesson is selected

steps.narration: Type a title for the lesson in the Lesson title box.
steps.expect: The title reads Sorting leaves by shape

steps.narration: In the Subject list, choose Science.
Set the Length to 30 minutes, which suits a short lesson outdoors.
Select the Notes box. This is where you write the plan itself.
steps.expect: The notes box has the focus

steps.value: Walk around the school field and collect ten leaves.
steps.narration: Type the first line of the plan.
steps.expect: The notes hold the first line

steps.narration: Open the Insert menu on the toolbar.
Choose Learning objective. A new line that starts with Objective appears in the notes.

steps.value: group leaves by their shape and edge.
steps.narration: Finish the objective in your own words.
Open the Insert menu again.
This time, choose Homework line.
Type the homework for the class.
Under Things to bring, select Add item.
steps.expect: An empty item is added and has the focus

steps.narration: Type the first thing the class needs, paper bags.
Select Add item again for a second line.
steps.expect: A second empty item has the focus

steps.narration: Type magnifying glasses.
Now select Lesson settings on the toolbar.
steps.expect: The Lesson settings dialog is open

steps.narration: Select Share this lesson with the class page, so your class can see the plan.
Select Remind me the day before, as well.
Select OK to close the settings.
Press Control and S to save the lesson. The status bar at the bottom says it is saved.
steps.expect: The status bar says the lesson is saved

steps.narration: Your new lesson is at the end of the list on the left. Scroll down to find it.
steps.expect: The last lesson in the list is visible

steps.narration: Select it any time to open the plan again.
steps.expect: Sorting leaves by shape is selected
